rule_description: Portfolio drawdown defense: reduce equity exposure when V57f portfolio drawdown from prior high exceeds a pre-declared threshold family, not a fitted threshold.
economic_intuition: Large portfolio drawdowns may indicate regime stress or factor unwind; reducing exposure can limit tail loss.
required_data: V57f daily NAV; prior peak NAV; exposure/cash ledger
pit_requirement: Only past NAV through decision date; threshold family must be pre-registered.

rule_description: Broad-market trend defense using long-term trend of CSI 300 / CSI Dividend / broad A-share index.
economic_intuition: A low-vol dividend basket can still suffer in market-wide stress; broad trend may proxy risk appetite.
required_data: Historical index daily close; index calendar; V57f daily NAV
pit_requirement: Index data must be available at rebalance or overlay decision date; no future index constituents.
expected_benefit: Reduce exposure during broad bear state
possible_cost: May miss sharp rebounds; cash drag
allowed_next_stage: PIT data audit then Quant design

rule_description: Portfolio volatility target: scale exposure down when realized portfolio volatility enters a pre-declared high-vol state.
economic_intuition: Higher realized volatility can signal larger left-tail risk and lower risk budget.
required_data: V57f daily returns; rolling realized volatility; cash ledger
pit_requirement: Rolling window uses only prior returns; windows pre-registered.
allowed_next_stage: PIT data audit then Quant design

rule_description: Sleeve overweight peak trimming: when a sleeve drifts materially above target due to gains, rebalance back to target sleeve weight.
economic_intuition: Rebalancing realizes sleeve-level mean reversion while preserving long-term cash-flow assets.
required_data: Sleeve weights; sleeve NAVs; target sleeve weights; transaction costs
pit_requirement: Only current holdings and prior close values; drift bands pre-registered.
possible_cost: May trim winners too early; turnover

rule_description: Extreme market protection state library: use 2022-03, 2024-01 and 2026 weak periods only to define candidate PIT risk-state variables, not parameters.
economic_intuition: Known stress cases reveal what data would have been visible ex ante.
required_data: V57f daily returns; broad index returns; volatility; breadth; rates; valuation
pit_requirement: All stress indicators must have visible dates before the stress response date.

rule_description: Dividend safety defense: lower sleeve risk budget when disclosed payout, OCF, earnings quality or dividend continuity deteriorates.
economic_intuition: Dividend/FCF strategies can suffer when yield reflects distress rather than sustainable payout.
required_data: PIT dividends; OCF; earnings; payout ratio; announcement dates
pit_requirement: Financial data must use original announcement and visible dates.

rule_description: Valuation heat peak trimming: restrict new buys or rebalance to target when dividend/low-vol basket valuation becomes historically expensive.
economic_intuition: High valuation can compress future returns and increase reversal risk.
required_data: PIT valuation metrics for portfolio/sleeves; historical distribution available to date
pit_requirement: Percentiles computed expanding through prior date only; no future distribution.

rule_description: Cash restoration rule: after defense triggers, restore target exposure only after a pre-declared recovery condition, not discretionary judgement.
economic_intuition: Avoid permanent cash drag and discretionary market timing after defensive cuts.
required_data: Overlay state; cash ledger; recovery signal
pit_requirement: Recovery signal must be PIT and pre-registered.

rule_description: Threshold rebalancing: rebalance sleeve weights when drift exceeds a pre-declared band, independent of historical return ranking.
economic_intuition: Keeps sleeve risk budget stable and avoids concentration without changing stock selection.
required_data: Sleeve NAVs; target weights; transaction cost model
pit_requirement: Drift based on observable current portfolio weights.

rule_description: Cash sleeve policy: defensive cash remains cash or pre-approved conservative asset only; benchmark impact and cash drag are reported separately.
economic_intuition: Cash management must be governed so defense is not hidden alpha from unapproved assets.
required_data: Cash ledger; conservative asset data if later approved
pit_requirement: If non-cash asset is used, source and PIT data must be approved first.
